purpose: functional verification of automatic checkpoints on KVM; no timings and no comparison with another product

cases.name: a sandbox with an interval is checkpointed an interval after it starts, unasked
rolling back to it restores the file and the running process with its memory
after use it is replaced by a newer one, and there is still one
left alone with nothing running, it is not checkpointed again
a sandbox without an interval is never checkpointed
too short an interval and a caller's `auto` are refused; a named one still saves
